name: Dunk Package: Showtime
description: Daily Spin exclusive, tier 3: wraps the ball around his back in mid-air before the slam, plus 360s, windmills and double clutches with the hardest posters.

name: Celebration: Too Small
description: Daily Spin exclusive celebration.

name: Jumpshot Base: Silk
description: Daily Spin exclusive. One silky motion from the hip with no set point: the ball glides up the middle while the legs drift forward together.

name: Jumpshot Release: Butter
description: Daily Spin exclusive. Smooth release: the wrist rolls through a slow, relaxed circle.

name: Jumpshot Base: Kick Out
description: One leg kicks out on the way up. Rhythm shooter feel.

name: Jumpshot Base: Wide Stance
description: Feet wide, low dip, a sturdy set. A touch more forgiving, a touch slower.

name: Jumpshot Release: Feather
description: Soft wrist; the guide hand stays up and open out to the side. Smooth and readable.

name: Jumpshot Release: Dart
description: Flat, fast and straight at the rim: the arm is thrown out in front at eye level.

name: Jumpshot Release: Rainbow
description: Sky-high arc; the hand keeps tracing the rainbow up and over after the ball is gone.

name: Dunk Package: Rim Rocker
description: Two-hand hammers: both hands take it back behind the head with the knees kicked up behind, then he hangs on the rim. No requirements.

name: Size-Up Package: Rhythm
description: A little bounce to every dribble move. No requirements.

name: Celebration: Too Easy
description: Palms up, shoulders up. Plays after big plays.

name: Celebration: Salute
description: A sharp salute to the crowd.

name: Celebration: Hand on Heart
description: Taps the heart, points to the sky.

name: Jumpshot Base: Sniper
description: Compact, square and quick. Requires 75 overall and 80 three point.

name: Jumpshot Release: Laser
description: The quickest clean release in the store, finished with the guide hand up at the brow like a visor. Requires 85 three point.

name: Dunk Package: Contact Dunks
description: Through-the-chest finishes: the lead shoulder goes into the defender with the ball held high and away, then one hand throws it down. Requires 80 driving dunk and 70 strength.

name: Dunk Package: High Flyer
description: The full showcase, led by the Superman: stretched out toward the rim, legs trailing straight back, the ball held out in front at arm's length all the way in. Requires 85 overall, 90 driving dunk, 85 vertical and All-Star rep.

name: Size-Up Package: Ankle Taker
description: The fastest combos in the park. Requires 80 overall and 90 ball handle.

name: Celebration: Crown
description: Puts the crown on. Requires 80 overall.

name: Jumpshot Base: Fadeaway
description: Drifts back on every jumper, legs split, shoulders open. Requires 70 mid-range.

name: Jumpshot Base: Hitch
description: Knees snap up and a beat at the top before it goes.

name: Jumpshot Base: Slingshot
description: Low set from the chest, heels kicked back, all in one motion.

name: Jumpshot Base: Scissor Kick
description: Legs scissor in the air: one forward, one back.

name: Jumpshot Base: Knee Tuck
description: Both knees tuck up toward the chest at the top of the jump.

name: Jumpshot Base: Sway
description: Leans into the shooting side while the off leg floats out wide. Requires 75 overall and 82 three point.

name: Jumpshot Release: Wave
description: Holds the gooseneck and waves the fingers on the way down.

name: Jumpshot Release: Statue
description: Arm stays frozen high long after the ball is gone; the guide hand drops instantly.

name: Jumpshot Release: Snatch Back
description: A hard snap, then the hand gets snatched back to the chest.

name: Jumpshot Release: Old School
description: Both hands follow through together, thumbs down.

name: Jumpshot Release: Point
description: Follows through, then points the shooting hand at the rim. Requires 70 three point.

name: Jumpshot Release: Cobra
description: The tallest gooseneck in the park: elbow above the head, wrist curled all the way down. Requires 80 overall, 88 three point and Starter rep.

name: Dunk Package: Hammer
description: Cocks it back over his shoulder, body twisted, and swings it down across like a hammer. Requires 72 driving dunk.

name: Dunk Package: Liberty
description: Statue of Liberty: the ball held straight up and back at full extension. Requires 78 driving dunk.

name: Dunk Package: Scoop
description: Scoops it up from the hip and rocks it in underhand. Requires 80 driving dunk.

name: Dunk Package: Hand Switch
description: Switches hands in the air before the slam. Requires 82 driving dunk and 75 vertical.

name: Dunk Package: Half Spin
description: Turns his back to the rim and throws it down backward. Requires 85 driving dunk and 78 vertical.

name: Dunk Package: Eastbay
description: Between the legs in mid-air. The rarest finishes in the park, with the camera and the crowd to match. Requires 87 overall, 92 driving dunk, 90 vertical and Superstar rep.

name: Dunk Package: Hash-Slinging
description: The Slasher Icon's own: six long streetball finishes that pass the ball round the body in the air and put most defenders flat on their back. Comes with the Hash-Slinging Icon badge; it cannot be bought.

name: Block Package: Fundamentals
description: The basics: a straight reach, a two-hand wall, a late hand, a side reach. Every build starts with it.

name: Block Package: Swatter
description: The arm cocks and fires: a volleyball swat, a chest swat, a cross-arm wipe, a hook, a shield, a lean-in.

name: Block Package: Wiper
description: Big swings with a stare after: the windshield wiper, a spike, a double clutch, a pin, a chase-down swat, a twist.

name: Block Package: Hammer
description: Emphatic: the hammer, a spike with a roar, a palm snatch, a scissor, a superman chase-down, a backboard pin. Your name on the callout.

name: Block Package: Eraser
description: The flashiest blocks in the park: the hammer fist, a sky pin, the finger wag, the eraser, a thunder clap, a launch.

name: Size-Up Package: Pound
description: Hard, low pound dribbles with the shoulders square and the head nodding.

name: Size-Up Package: Snake
description: Hips sway side to side, the ball slithering low between the hands. Requires 75 ball handle.

name: Size-Up Package: Crab
description: Wide crab stance with half-step shuffles. Requires 70 ball handle.

name: Size-Up Package: Stutter
description: Feet chop and stutter with hesitation pauses to freeze the defender. Requires 85 ball handle.

name: Size-Up Package: Showtime
description: Behind-the-back and through-the-legs flourishes with a spin of the head. Requires 85 overall, 92 ball handle and All-Star rep.

name: Celebration: Goggles
description: Three-point goggles over the eyes.

name: Celebration: Dust Off
description: Brushes the dirt off both shoulders.

name: Celebration: Airplane
description: Arms out, banking left and right.

name: Celebration: Mic Drop
description: Holds the mic up high and lets it go. Requires 75 overall.

name: Celebration: Take a Bow
description: One hand across the waist, a deep bow.

name: Celebration: Roar
description: Arms flexed down at the sides, chest out, a big roar.

name: Layup Package: Basic
description: Straight-ahead layups off one foot.

name: Layup Package: Euro Step
description: Every drive ends with a long euro step across the lane. Requires 70 layup.

name: Layup Package: Finger Roll
description: Long reach and a soft finger roll off the fingertips.

name: Layup Package: Scoop
description: Underhand scoops that swing in low under the defender. Requires 78 layup.

name: Glow Mo-Cap Suit Top
description: The King Tut Cup grand prize. A black motion-capture suit with glow-in-the-dark tracking markers and seams. Only the winner of a Cup gets it.

name: Glow Mo-Cap Suit Tights
description: The King Tut Cup grand prize. Tights to match the mo-cap suit top, markers down both legs.

name: Pharaoh Lo / Gold Glow
description: King Tut Cup exclusive (top 3). Black and gold with a glow-in-the-dark sole.

name: Scarab Glow Headband
description: King Tut Cup exclusive (top 25). Glows in the dark.

name: Celebration: Pharaoh
description: King Tut Cup exclusive (top 10). Arms crossed over the chest like a pharaoh in his tomb, then the crook-and-flail pose.

name: Jumpshot Base: Pogo
description: Two quick bounces on the dip, then straight up with the legs locked together. Light and springy.

name: Jumpshot Base: Stork
description: The off-side knee drives up high in front on the way up, the shooting leg hangs straight.

name: Jumpshot Base: Frog
description: Sits low and wide, then rises with the knees flared out and the soles nearly together.

name: Jumpshot Base: Corkscrew
description: Ankles cross and the hips turn off the line while the shoulders stay square to the rim. A touch slower.

name: Jumpshot Base: Heel Kick
description: The off-side heel kicks up behind him at the top. Neutral timing.

name: Jumpshot Base: Turbo
description: Barely leaves the floor: the quickest base in the game (10% faster), with the tightest window.

name: Jumpshot Base: 1-2 Step
description: Steps into it and swings the shooting-side leg through high and straight. A little more forgiving.

name: Jumpshot Base: Tilt
description: Tips over toward the shooting side in the air. Releases high, a bit tighter.

name: Jumpshot Base: Catapult
description: Loads it behind the head with the back arched and slings it. Slow, and a little tight.

name: Jumpshot Base: Statue
description: Stiff as a board and leaning in, with a long hold at the set point. Slow, but forgiving.

name: Jumpshot Base: Bounce
description: A small step-in and a wide, soft landing stance in the air. Quick and forgiving.

name: Jumpshot Base: Whip
description: One motion from the off-side hip across the body and up: quick, a touch tight.

name: Jumpshot Base: Deep Dip
description: Takes the ball all the way down to the knees and rises: the slowest base, the most forgiving.

name: Jumpshot Base: Leaner
description: Falls forward into the shot with both legs trailing behind. Quick.

name: Jumpshot Base: Bicycle
description: The legs keep pedalling through the whole jump. Neutral timing, all style.

name: Flick Up Release
description: Quick, and the fingers snap straight up to the sky.

name: Fist Pump Release
description: Quick: the hand closes and pumps down to the chest before he lands.

name: Wingspan Release
description: Both arms open out wide to the sides after the release.

name: Drop Release
description: Both arms drop to his sides the moment the ball's gone. All business.

name: Curl Release
description: The shooting arm curls back to the shoulder.

name: Long Reach Release
description: Held out at full stretch toward the rim, the guide hand already down.

name: Swipe Release
description: The guide hand sweeps across in front of the chest.

name: Cap Tip Release
description: Brings the hand down to the brow and tips the cap.

name: Pendulum Release
description: The arm swings through a big arc down past the hip.

name: Touchdown Release
description: Both arms locked straight up in a V, held.

name: Chop Release
description: A karate chop straight down in front to the waist.

name: Needle Release
description: Traces the ball's line out and down, like threading a needle at the rim.

name: Goose Hook Release
description: The wrist hooks all the way over and the hand drops behind the head.

name: Wipe Down Release
description: The guide hand wipes along the shooting forearm, elbow to wrist.

name: Loose Release
description: The whole arm shakes loose from the shoulder, held.

name: Big Stretch Release
description: The slowest release: both arms up and back in a long stretch.
Both knees tucked up to the chest, then a two-hand slam. Finishes through contact a bit better.

description: The lead knee drives all the way to the chest while the ball stays low, then it's thrown up and in.

description: Two pumps at arm's length at eye level, then up and in with both hands.
name: Dunk Package: Pump Fake

description: The lead leg shoots out straight ahead like a hurdler; one hand.
name: Dunk Package: Hurdler

description: Ankles crossed in the air while the ball swings across the body from the far shoulder.
name: Dunk Package: Cross Legs

description: Folds in half: legs piked out in front, the ball reaching long over the top.
name: Dunk Package: Jackknife

description: A big windmill out to the side of the body: in at the shoulder, down, out wide, over the top.
name: Dunk Package: Side Mill

description: Both hands take it all the way round together, legs straddled wide.
name: Dunk Package: Two-Hand Mill

description: Both hands up early while the legs go out in a full side split.
name: Dunk Package: Splits

description: Up over the head, dropped down the back between the shoulder blades, then whipped over the top.
name: Dunk Package: Backscratcher

description: Passed behind the head from the right hand to the left and slammed left-handed.
name: Dunk Package: Behind the Head

description: A full turn with the ball held out to the side at arm's length, like a rotor.
name: Dunk Package: Helicopter

description: A full reverse spin with the ball held high over the head in both hands.
name: Dunk Package: Reverse 360

description: The flashiest finish in the store: a full spin with the arm windmilling right round through it.
name: Dunk Package: 360 Mill
Layup Package: Reverse
description: Goes under the rim and finishes on the other side, head back over the shoulder. Late release, a bit tight.

name: Layup Package: Hop Step
description: A two-foot hop on the gather and a two-hand finish. Forgiving.

name: Layup Package: Floater
description: Lets it go early and high out in front: the earliest release of any package.

name: Layup Package: Spin
description: A full spin through the gather steps, then up. The longest gather, a bit tight.
A tall, slow, high yo-yo pound with the head bobbing to it. 4% quicker moves.

description: Sits low and wide with the ball cradled side to side under him. 10% quicker moves.
name: Size-Up Package: Cradle

description: Smooth hip slides from side to side, through the legs now and then. 6% quicker moves.
name: Size-Up Package: Glide

description: Heavy jab steps at the defender between dribbles. 2% quicker moves.

description: Bouncing on the toes the whole time, quick crossovers. 12% quicker moves.

description: Upright, slow and wide, shoulders swaying: all attitude. Moves as they come.

description: The fastest crossovers in the game, one after another. 30% quicker moves.
name: Size-Up Package: Blur

Movement: Standard
description: How everybody moves. Free.

name: Movement: Smooth
description: Long, easy strides with a quiet upper body.

name: Movement: Bouncy
description: Springs off every step, head bobbing along.

name: Movement: Swagger
description: Shoulders swinging, arms out wide, leaning back a touch, head cocked.

name: Movement: Heavy
description: A big man's walk: low, wide and heavy-footed.

name: Movement: Shifty
description: Short, choppy, low steps: always ready to change direction.

name: Movement: Upright
description: Tall and straight, chin up.

name: Movement: Hunched
description: Head down and shoulders forward, all business.

name: Movement: Loose
description: Arms swinging wide and free, shoulders rolling.

name: Movement: Strut
description: Chest out, knees high, a slow arm swing.

name: Movement: Glide
description: Long, flat, gliding strides: the feet barely leave the floor.

name: Movement: Sprinter
description: High knees and pumping arms everywhere he goes.

name: Movement: Laid Back
description: Leaning back, arms barely moving, head tilted: nothing to prove.

name: Classic Chime
description: The green chime everybody starts with: two bright, glassy notes when your green goes in.

name: Eagle Screech
description: A raptor's piercing scream: a quick rise into a long, raspy "kee-eeee-arrr" that tears down at the end and rings off the canyon walls.

name: Greeen Chant
description: The whole park chants "GREEEEN!" and roars after it.

name: Cha-Ching
description: The keys clunk, the bell sings "ching!" and the drawer rolls out onto the coins. Money.

name: Air Horn
description: Short, short, loooong. Nobody in the park can miss it.

name: Jackpot
description: The reels clatter to a stop, then the alarm bell rings and rings while the coins pour into the tray.

name: Rubber Duck
description: Squee-squee: a rubber duck squeezed twice, wheezing in between. Disrespectful.

name: Laser Blast
description: Pew, pew, then a charged-up big shot.

name: Big Gong
description: A big gong struck once: the deep note, then the shimmer blooming out over the courts.

name: Level Up
description: An 8-bit fanfare on two pulse channels and a triangle bass: you just leveled up.

name: Thunderclap
description: The air tears open right overhead, then the boom and the long roll of thunder.

name: Kazoo Charge
description: The bugle charge call, hummed through a kazoo. Charge!

name: Heavenly Choir
description: A choir swells into one perfect chord in a cathedral, a harp running up under it. Angelic.

name: Cannonball
description: A cannonball into the deep end: the slap, the kerplunk, the spray and the drips.

name: Slide Whistle
description: Fweeeee-oop! A slide whistle all the way up, and a flick at the top.

name: Night Owl
description: A great horned owl in the dark: hoo, h'hoo-hoo, hooo, hooo, with the crickets behind him.

name: Wolf Howl
description: A wolf howls at the moon, long and wavering, and another one answers from further off.

name: Steam Whistle
description: A steam locomotive's chime whistle: two long, mournful blasts down the line.

name: Victory Bells
description: The church bells ring out down the scale, every bell humming and shimmering.

name: Knockout Bell
description: Ding, ding, ding! The bell at ringside. It's over.

name: Shattered Glass
description: A pane smashed: the crack, the crash, and the shards tinkling as they bounce.

name: Strike!
description: The ball rumbles down the lane, cracks into the pocket and the pins go flying.

name: Rimshot
description: Ba-dum, tss. The drummer's punchline.

name: Bass Drop
description: The build-up, one beat of nothing, then the drop: a wobbling 808 boom.

name: Sonar Ping
description: One pure ping into the deep, the long dark ring of the water, and the echo coming back. Target locked.

name: Standing Ovation
description: The whole gym on its feet: applause, cheering and a couple of finger whistles.

name: Five-Alarm
description: A fire siren winds up into its wail and growls back down. He's on fire.

name: Boing
description: Boyoyoyoing! A door-stop spring flicked. Cartoon physics.

name: Cuckoo
description: The little door clacks open: cu-ckoo, cu-ckoo. Somebody's defense is crazy.

name: Royal Fanfare
description: Three trumpets, ta-ta-ta TAAAA, over a timpani hit. Bow down.

name: Case Closed
description: The judge's gavel on the sound block: bang, bang, BANG. Case closed.

name: Green Burst
description: The green burst everybody starts with: a quick spray of green sparks over your head.

name: Green Fireworks
description: Three rockets climb off your head and break into green shells that crackle (four on a three).

name: Green Splash
description: A splash of green water bursts up off your head: a crown of droplets, a spout and the drips.

name: Green Flame
description: A green flame ignites over your head and burns for a moment, embers rising off it.

name: Green Lightning
description: A bolt comes down out of the sky onto your head, twice, and rings out across the floor.

name: Halo
description: A halo spins up over your head, then goes out in a shockwave.

name: Crowned
description: A crown of green light sits on your head, turning, then sparkles away.

name: Confetti Cannons
description: Confetti cannons go off at both shoulders and it flutters down around you.

name: Aurora Beam
description: A pillar of green light rises from the floor through you into the sky.

name: Smoke Ring
description: A ring of glowing green smoke rolls out at your feet and another floats up off your head.

name: Pixel Star
description: An 8-bit star pops up over you, blinks, and shatters into pixels.

name: Comet
description: A comet circles you twice on the way up, then shoots into the sky and bursts.

name: Twister
description: A green twister winds up around you from the floor and throws its sparks out.

name: Phoenix
description: A phoenix of green fire rises off your head, beating its wings and shedding embers, then bursts.

name: Make It Rain
description: A "$" of green light pops up over you, turns once, and bursts into bills that flutter down around you.

name: Shockwave
description: The release cracks the air: a flash, a column of light and three shock rings racing out across the floor.

name: Atomic
description: An atom over your head, three electrons orbiting and trailing light, then it splits.

name: Galaxy
description: A spiral galaxy turns over your head, then falls into its core and flashes.

name: Ice Cold
description: A snowflake crystal grows over you and shatters into falling ice, and frost rolls out at your feet.

name: Fire Circle
description: A circle of green fire runs round you on the floor, leaps up round you and bursts over your head.

name: Angel Wings
description: Wings of light unfold behind you, beat once, and come apart into drifting feathers.

name: Jade Dragon
description: A jade dragon winds up out of the floor around you and soars off into the sky.

name: Meteor Shower
description: Meteors streak down out of the sky and slam into the floor all around you (more on a three).

name: Laser Show
description: Laser beams fan out from over your head and sweep the sky.

name: Lucky Clover
description: A four-leaf clover pops up over you, spins, and bursts into gold.

name: Diamond
description: A cut diamond turns over your head, glinting at its corners, then shatters into sparks.

name: Supernova
description: Light rushes in to a point over your head, it flashes, and a shell of fire blows out with a ring round its middle.

name: Pharaoh's Horn
description: King Tut Cup exclusive (top 10). A ceremonial horn rising through an old scale, a sistrum rattle and a gong under the last note.

name: Golden Ankh
description: King Tut Cup exclusive (top 3). Sand swirls in around you and forms a golden ankh over your head, glowing, before it rises away.
